BriefKind.title: BriefKind
BriefKind.description:
The scheduled narrative brief flavors.

Each kind targets a different scope: pod-level daily summaries, project-level
weekly updates, and a single portfolio-wide executive brief.

CheckInPreferenceField.title: CheckInPreferenceField
CheckInPreferenceField.description: The preference fields a member can leave to the team default, in display order.

CheckInSendKind.title: CheckInSendKind
CheckInSendKind.description:
What the check-in schedule is, so a screen says only what is true of it.

``WEEKLY``: one time of day on days of the week, in every month (all seven
days is every day). ``DATES``: one time of day on listed days of the month
and/or in listed months, such as 1 January only. ``OTHER``: anything else,
such as a step or a range in the time; only the cron says when. ``OFF``:
the scheduled send is switched off (``OPENPROGRAM_CHECKIN_FANOUT_ENABLED``),
so nobody is asked on a schedule, whatever the cron says.

replied.title: Replied
replied.description: Gave the day's status themselves (confirmed or partial).

inferred.title: Inferred
inferred.description: Inferred from what moved in the tracker and Git.

no_data.title: No Data
no_data.description: Closed stale or unknown: nothing said, nothing moved.

waiting.title: Waiting
waiting.description: No status for the day yet.

causes.title: Causes
causes.description: Why the no-data days have none, counted per cause.

CheckinCoverageDto.title: CheckinCoverageDto
CheckinCoverageDto.description: How a pod's day was captured: "6 replied · 3 from Jira · 1 no data (no Jira link)".

local_time.title: Local Time
local_time.description: Never used to send: check-ins go out for everyone on the response's `send`.

CheckinDefaultsResponse.title: CheckinDefaultsResponse
CheckinDefaultsResponse.description: The team defaults a member follows for any field not set for them.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: An inferred day's lines of what moved in the tracker and Git; not the person's word.

no_data_cause.title: No Data Cause
no_data_cause.description: Why a day closed stale or unknown has no data.

asked_at.title: Asked At
asked_at.description: When the day's check-in first asked them; only where the ladder is read (reads_ladder).

replied_at.title: Replied At
replied_at.description: When their first reply of the day was recorded; null while none is, or where the ladder is not read.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: The day's silence-ladder rungs that went out for them, oldest first: a reminder to them, then their scrum master and manager told. Only where the ladder is read.

checkin_time.title: Checkin Time
checkin_time.description: Their check-in time (HH:MM, in `timezone`): an admin's and their own pod's scrum master's read only (reads_schedule).

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the reconcile tick fills the day from Jira for members the check-in never reached (the send off, or a send that failed).

source.title: Source
source.description: 'default' while an admin never saved it (on), 'tenant' once saved.

deployment_enabled.title: Deployment Enabled
deployment_enabled.description: The deployment's own switch (OPENPROGRAM_CHECKIN_FILL_ENABLED); off wins.

CheckinFillResponse.title: CheckinFillResponse
CheckinFillResponse.description: The tenant's switch "Fill the day from Jira for people who were not asked".

local_time.title: Local Time
local_time.description: Stored for the member, and never used to send: check-ins go out for everyone on `send`.

inherited.title: Inherited
inherited.description: Fields not set for this member. Their values above are the team defaults, and a change to those defaults reaches this member.

send.description: When the bot asks: one tenant-wide send, or none while `kind` is `off`. The member's `weekdays` decide whether they are asked on a send day; their `timezone` decides which day a reply counts for, not when they are asked.

CheckinPreferenceResponse.title: CheckinPreferenceResponse
CheckinPreferenceResponse.description: A member's check-in preference as it applies: their own values, else the team's.

CheckinPreferenceUpdateRequest.title: CheckinPreferenceUpdateRequest
CheckinPreferenceUpdateRequest.description:
An admin's change to a member's check-in preference.

A field left out keeps what is stored. A field sent as ``null`` is cleared,
so the member follows the team default for it again.

number.title: Number
number.description: Its place on the ladder: 1 is the reminder to the person.

target.title: Target
target.description: developer (a reminder to the person), scrum_master or manager; null when the rung was not recorded and today's ladder has no rung of that number.

recorded.title: Recorded
recorded.description: Whom it was for was recorded when it went out; false: read from today's ladder, for a rung sent before rungs were recorded.

CheckinRungDto.title: CheckinRungDto
CheckinRungDto.description: One rung of the day's silence ladder that went out: whom it was for, and when.

kind.description: What the schedule is. `weekly`: one time on days of the week (`local_time`, `weekdays`). `dates`: one time on listed days of the month and/or in listed months (`local_time`, `month_days`, `months`), such as 1 January only. `other`: anything else, such as a step or a range in the time; only `cron` says when. `off`: the scheduled send is switched off (OPENPROGRAM_CHECKIN_FANOUT_ENABLED), so nobody is asked on a schedule; `cron` is what applies once it is on again, and every other field is null.

cron.title: Cron
cron.description: The tenant's check-in schedule as configured (OPENPROGRAM_CHECKIN_FANOUT_CRON). Every member is asked on it, unless `kind` is `off`; nobody has a time of their own.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: The zone the schedule is read in: always UTC.

local_time.title: Local Time
local_time.description: The clock time of the send in `timezone`; null when `kind` is `other` or `off`.

weekdays.title: Weekdays
weekdays.description: `weekly` only: the days the bot sends, Monday 0, judged by the send's date in `timezone`; all seven is every day. Null for any other kind. A member is asked only on those of these days that are in their own `weekdays`.

month_days.title: Month Days
month_days.description: `dates` only: the days of the month the bot sends on, 1 to 31; null for any day of the month (then `months` is set).

months.title: Months
months.description: `dates` only: the months the bot sends in, January 1; null for every month (then `month_days` is set).

CheckinSendResponse.title: CheckinSendResponse
CheckinSendResponse.description: When the bot asks: one send of the check-ins for the whole tenant.

environment_configured.title: Environment Configured
environment_configured.description: The server's own settings configure this connector. They are used while the tenant has no enabled connection of its own.

updated_by_name.title: Updated By Name
updated_by_name.description: The display name of the member who last saved it, or null when updated_by is no member's id.

ConnectionResponse.title: ConnectionResponse
ConnectionResponse.description:
One connector and the tenant's connection to it.

Secret values are never returned: ``secrets_set`` names the secret fields
that hold a stored value, so the console can show "set" next to them.

ConnectionTestRequest.title: ConnectionTestRequest
ConnectionTestRequest.description:
Optional unsaved values to test over the stored ones.

A secret left out uses the stored one, but only while every address and
sign-in field is as saved: a test that changes one must carry each secret
it uses, or it is refused with 400. A secret mapped to null or blank is
cleared for the test and never falls back to the stored one. Leave the
whole body out to test what is saved; only that test is recorded on the
connection.

ConnectionUpdateRequest.title: ConnectionUpdateRequest
ConnectionUpdateRequest.description:
Save a connection.

``settings`` replaces the plain settings (a blank or null value clears a
field). ``secrets`` only changes the secrets it names: a value stores it, a
blank or null clears it, and a secret left out keeps its stored value.

ConnectorPurpose.title: ConnectorPurpose
ConnectorPurpose.description: What OpenProgram uses a connector for.

ConversationResponse.title: ConversationResponse
ConversationResponse.description:
The person's own conversation of one day, read-only, oldest first.

``kept`` False: past the retention window, so nothing is shown and
``note`` says why.

CrossPersonDelivery.title: CrossPersonDelivery
CrossPersonDelivery.description: Whether the counterpart has been sent the DM about a request.

release_id.title: Release Id
release_id.description: Report on one release of the project only.

project_name.title: Project Name
project_name.description: Null when the project no longer exists.

destinations.title: Destinations
destinations.description: Exactly where it goes; empty for a reader who may not set the report up.

audience_summary.title: Audience Summary
audience_summary.description: Where it goes in one line, such as "3 people by direct message".

note.description: The note today's report opens with, if anyone wrote one.

can_send.title: Can Send
can_send.description: The caller may send it now.

can_edit.title: Can Edit
can_edit.description: The caller may change, switch or remove it.

can_write_note.title: Can Write Note
can_write_note.description: The caller may write the note today's report opens with.

DayReportResponse.title: DayReportResponse
DayReportResponse.description: A day report as the caller may see it, with what the caller may do with it.

DayReportSetupResponse.title: DayReportSetupResponse
DayReportSetupResponse.description:
What setting a report up can pick from: the projects the caller may report on,
the people it can go to, and the kinds of destination with whether each can be used.

DeadLetterStatus.title: DeadLetterStatus
DeadLetterStatus.description:
Lifecycle of a dead-lettered workflow event.

``OPEN`` means the event exhausted its durable retries and awaits operator
action; ``REARMED`` means an operator re-triggered processing for it.

DeliveryImpactResponse.title: DeliveryImpactResponse
DeliveryImpactResponse.description: Why one scope's forecast moved over a period: then, now, and each driver between.

target.title: Target
target.description: The exact destination; empty for a reader who may not set the report up.

label.title: Label
label.description: Who or where, as the reader may see it: a person's name, else the exact destination for whoever sets the report up, else what kind of place it is.

requirement_types.title: Requirement Types
requirement_types.description: Issue types that count as requirements. Empty counts every type.

DeliveryStagesResponse.title: DeliveryStagesResponse
DeliveryStagesResponse.description: Which tracker statuses count as which delivery stage.

rag.description: The node's colour, only where the caller reads it; null for a name only.

access.description: What its Delivery panel shows the caller: 'panel' all of it, 'dates' a pod's dates and colour, 'name' its name and nothing to open.

own.title: Own
own.description: A pod the caller belongs to or runs.

parent_ids.title: Parent Ids
parent_ids.description: A project's programs; a pod's projects among those listed.

DeliveryTreeNodeResponse.title: DeliveryTreeNodeResponse
DeliveryTreeNodeResponse.description: One program, project or pod of the caller's own part of the delivery tree.

DeliveryTreeResponse.title: DeliveryTreeResponse
DeliveryTreeResponse.description: The caller's own part of the delivery tree, for their Delivery and palette.

DevUserResponse.title: DevUserResponse
DevUserResponse.description: One switchable person for the local demo persona picker.

DirectoryPersonResponse.title: DirectoryPersonResponse
DirectoryPersonResponse.description:
A person named in a node's metadata (``key``, e.g. ``owner_id``).

``member_id`` and ``name`` are null when ``id`` matches no member.

DriftFindingResponse.title: DriftFindingResponse
DriftFindingResponse.description:
A continuous drift ("watermelon") finding for persona risk views.

Carries only derived, sanitised fields -- never raw DM/reply content -- so
the stated-vs-actual divergence is explicit alongside signal-only risks.

EscalationContactUpdateDto.title: EscalationContactUpdateDto
EscalationContactUpdateDto.description: Pick a member. A bare chat id is kept only if it is a member's or already stored.

after_days.title: After Days
after_days.description: Days an ask of each kind waits before it reaches this level; a kind left out never reaches it.

decision_owner_id.title: Decision Owner Id
decision_owner_id.description: Who owns a decision nothing else names an owner for: the product owner.

levels.title: Levels
levels.description: Level 2 first; level 1 is always the ask's owner.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: Empty for the tenant's own matrix.

EvidenceResponse.title: EvidenceResponse
EvidenceResponse.description: What explains pace without a share of its own.

FieldConditionDto.title: FieldConditionDto
FieldConditionDto.description: The field (or option) applies only while ``field`` holds one of ``values``.

write_back.title: Write Back
write_back.description: How the person's updates reach the tracker: auto (written at once), ask (written when they tick it in the console, or say yes in chat) or off.

tracker_status.title: Tracker Status
tracker_status.description: The tracker's own status name, for a synced task; null otherwise.

my_eta.title: My Eta
my_eta.description: The person's own latest ETA for the task (its last day); null when none.

my_eta_label.title: My Eta Label
my_eta_label.description: That ETA as it was given: 'Oct 9' from the console, 'early next week' from chat.

blocker_ids.title: Blocker Ids
blocker_ids.description: The person's open blockers on this task, ids from blocker_details.

can_move_in_tracker.title: Can Move In Tracker
can_move_in_tracker.description: The person is the synced tracker issue's assignee through their identity link. The tick to move the issue also needs write_back other than off.

observed.description: What the tracker says of the task today, never merged into last_update.

reconstructed.title: Reconstructed
reconstructed.description: True when the day was rebuilt later from the stored snapshots, not kept on the day.

ForecastDayResponse.title: ForecastDayResponse
ForecastDayResponse.description:
What history forecast on one day that kept a snapshot; p50 and p85 are null when
there was too little history, or nothing finished in it, to forecast.

needed_days.title: Needed Days
needed_days.description: Working days of history each day's forecast needed before it gave dates.

ForecastHistoryResponse.title: ForecastHistoryResponse
ForecastHistoryResponse.description: The project's, or one release's, history forecast as it stood on each day.

days.title: Days
days.description: How many days before today to rebuild from the stored snapshots.

min_history_days.title: Min History Days
min_history_days.description: Working days of history before a forecast gives its 50% and 85% dates.

default_min_history_days.title: Default Min History Days
default_min_history_days.description: The deployment's default, used while the tenant has set none.

lowest.title: Lowest
lowest.description: The fewest working days that may be set.

highest.title: Highest
highest.description: The most working days that may be set.

window_days.title: Window Days
window_days.description: The calendar days of snapshots a forecast reads, which follow the minimum.

ForecastSettingsResponse.title: ForecastSettingsResponse
ForecastSettingsResponse.description: How many working days of history the tenant's delivery forecasts need.

min_history_days.title: Min History Days
min_history_days.description: Working days of history before a forecast gives dates; null uses the default.

GateBoardResponse.title: GateBoardResponse
GateBoardResponse.description: A project's (or release's) requirements against their gates, and open questions.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: A few words for under the cell's colour, e.g. '3 of 4 unanswered today' or 'Blocker on SHOP-8 (Ada)'; for an unknown cell, why it has no status. Names people, never ids. Optional, so older clients keep working.

reasons.title: Reasons
reasons.description: Every reason behind the cell's colour, worst first, for a tooltip.

needed_days.title: Needed Days
needed_days.description: Working days of history the forecast needs before it gives dates.

HygieneBoardResponse.title: HygieneBoardResponse
HygieneBoardResponse.description: A project's (or a pod's) Jira hygiene: each rule's counts, then the issues that break it.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: added_after_baseline_without_label: the change labels (empty: the planning baseline's and the tenant's); missing_label: any of these.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: A profile id (GET /profiles), for kind profile.

rule_id.title: Rule Id
rule_id.description: Empty creates one; an example's id adds it.

severity.description: list_only shows it on Overall and counts it; ask also asks its owner.

every_type.title: Every Type
every_type.description: False looks only at the requirements the stage mapping counts.

HygieneSelectDto.title: HygieneSelectDto
HygieneSelectDto.description: Which of a scope's issues the rule looks at: every matcher must match.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: The scan checks every hour; off, a tick does nothing.

change_labels.title: Change Labels
change_labels.description: The tenant's labels for scope agreed after planning; empty keeps CR.

without_chat_id.title: Without Chat Id
without_chat_id.description: No chat id: the check-in cannot reach them.

without_jira_account.title: Without Jira Account
without_jira_account.description: Neither a Jira account nor a Jira email: their day cannot be read from Jira.

IdentityCountsResponse.title: IdentityCountsResponse
IdentityCountsResponse.description: Admin › Directory: members with no chat id and with no Jira account.

InvestigateAnswerEvent.title: InvestigateAnswerEvent
InvestigateAnswerEvent.description: The last line of an answered investigation.

InvestigateEvent.title: InvestigateEvent
InvestigateEvent.description: One line of POST /ask/investigate's newline-delimited JSON, told apart by type.

InvestigateFailedEvent.title: InvestigateFailedEvent
InvestigateFailedEvent.description: The last line of an investigation that could not answer, and why.

InvestigatePlanEvent.title: InvestigatePlanEvent
InvestigatePlanEvent.description: The first line: the steps the question was split into, all still running.

InvestigateStepEvent.title: InvestigateStepEvent
InvestigateStepEvent.description: A step that finished, done or failed, in the order steps finish.

InvestigateStepResponse.title: InvestigateStepResponse
InvestigateStepResponse.description: One step of an investigation: its question, how it went, and what it found.

passed_without.title: Passed Without
passed_without.description: Gates whose stage the issue reached without passing them.

JiraChangeAnswerResponse.title: JiraChangeAnswerResponse
JiraChangeAnswerResponse.description: What the answer did. ``already_answered``: the chat (or another tab) answered first.

JiraChangeDto.title: JiraChangeDto
JiraChangeDto.description:
One change waiting for the person's yes.

``kind``: ``proposal`` (from a check-in), ``suggestion`` (a merged merge
request, the issue still open) or ``due_date`` (no answer here: change it
in the tracker). ``holds_checkin``: the day's check-in waits for this answer.

JiraChangeGateDto.title: JiraChangeGateDto
JiraChangeGateDto.description:
What a yes would meet now, read from the same gates the write passes.

``yes_allowed`` is False for every state but ``open`` and ``no_change``: the
console offers no yes a gate would refuse. A no is always allowed for a
proposal or a suggestion: it never writes.

JiraCreateProjectsDto.title: JiraCreateProjectsDto
JiraCreateProjectsDto.description: The Jira projects release readiness may create issues in.

JiraWriteKindDto.title: JiraWriteKindDto
JiraWriteKindDto.description: One kind of Jira write: its own switch, and whether it writes now.

JiraWritesChangeDto.title: JiraWritesChangeDto
JiraWritesChangeDto.description: One change an admin made: who, when, and the value before and after.

JiraWritesResponse.title: JiraWritesResponse
JiraWritesResponse.description: The tenant's Jira write switches as they are in force, and the latest changes.

JiraWritesUpdateRequest.title: JiraWritesUpdateRequest
JiraWritesUpdateRequest.description: Only what is given changes; a field left out or null keeps its value and source.

MarkerResponse.title: MarkerResponse
MarkerResponse.description: One kind of event on one day, on the timeline's impact lane.

Measure.title: Measure
Measure.description: Which forecast date a move is read on: the 85% date, as the verdict reads it.

MyRequestRelation.title: MyRequestRelation
MyRequestRelation.description: Which side of one's own cross-person requests to return.

verdict.title: Verdict
verdict.description: The one-line verdict of a structured brief; null for an older free-text brief, which a reader splits into sentences instead.

bullets.title: Bullets
bullets.description: A structured brief's bullets: what changed, what is at risk, who acts.

NodeAccess.title: NodeAccess
NodeAccess.description: What a node's Delivery panel shows the caller.

stage.description: Null when the status is not counted.

mapped.title: Mapped
mapped.description: False when no stage names the status and its broad state placed it.

stage.description: The delivery stage that status maps to.

since.title: Since
since.description: When the task entered that status, by the tracker's history.

moved_by.title: Moved By
moved_by.description: Who made that move, by name, when it was not one of the task's own people.

changes.title: Changes
changes.description: The day's other changes, worded: 'due date moved Oct 10 → Oct 14'.

quiet_days.title: Quiet Days
quiet_days.description: Days a task under way has not moved, from five on.

ObservedTaskDto.title: ObservedTaskDto
ObservedTaskDto.description: What the tracker says of a task today ("Jira today"), beside what its people said.

people.title: People
people.description: How many people a pod, project or program holds on the day; null for any other node, and for a group of fewer than five read by someone who counts people only (D99, D104).

reconstructed.title: Reconstructed
reconstructed.description: True when no snapshot of the day was kept and the requirements were rebuilt.

snapshot_day.title: Snapshot Day
snapshot_day.description: The snapshot the requirements were read from, when it is not planned_on.

points.title: Points
points.description: The story points frozen, when every requirement carried them.

in_scope.title: In Scope
in_scope.description: Requirements in scope on the day read.

PlanningBaselinesResponse.title: PlanningBaselinesResponse
PlanningBaselinesResponse.description: A project's or a release's baselines on the day read, newest first.

release_id.title: Release Id
release_id.description: One release of the project; null for the whole project.

planned_on.title: Planned On
planned_on.description: The day planning was complete; null for today. An earlier day freezes that day's stored snapshot.

change_label.title: Change Label
change_label.description: The Jira label of a change agreed after planning; null for the default "CR".

grace_working_days.title: Grace Working Days
grace_working_days.description: Working days after planning in which an added requirement counts as planned.

PlanningCompleteRequest.title: PlanningCompleteRequest
PlanningCompleteRequest.description: Mark planning complete for the project, or for one of its releases.

coverage.description: How the pod's day was captured, counted per pod.

reads_ladder.title: Reads Ladder
reads_ladder.description: The caller reads the day's silence ladder: asked and replied times and the rungs sent (a scrum master for their own pods, a manager, an admin).

reads_schedule.title: Reads Schedule
reads_schedule.description: The caller reads each person's check-in time and zone (an admin, and a scrum master of their own pods).

PodDeliveryResponse.title: PodDeliveryResponse
PodDeliveryResponse.description: A pod's part of each project it works on: what its scrum master commits.

last_update.description: The latest statement any owner made on the task: a state or a note.

last_update_by.title: Last Update By
last_update_by.description: The name of the owner who made that statement.

eta.title: Eta
eta.description: The owners' own ETA for the task: the latest day any of them gave.

eta_label.title: Eta Label
eta_label.description: That ETA as it was given: 'Oct 9' from the console, 'Tuesday' from chat.

observed.description: What the tracker says of the task today, never merged into last_update.

checkins.description: The day's check-in counts for the people in the program's teams; null for a reader who counts people only, when the program has fewer than five (D104).

PortfolioAttentionResponse.title: PortfolioAttentionResponse
PortfolioAttentionResponse.description:
What a director should know about a program on one day (Exec Today).

``headline`` is one plain sentence with the colour and its cause; ``detail``
the next drivers, or null. ``signals`` are at most five items to act on,
worst and oldest first; empty only when nothing needs attention.

computed_at.title: Computed At
computed_at.description: The newest kept row's time: 'as of HH:MM'.

PortfolioDeliveryResponse.title: PortfolioDeliveryResponse
PortfolioDeliveryResponse.description:
Every project the reader reads, worst first, from the kept forecast rows.

``counts`` cover every project the search matches (the verdict filter aside), so
each tile is a filter; ``total`` is how many match the filters, of which
``projects`` is the page from ``offset``.

entity_ref.description: What the event is about. Null for a reader who reads no person (an executive) when it is about one: a member's id names them as much as a name does.

person_name.title: Person Name
person_name.description: Who entity_ref is, by name, when it is a person: the member's name, else the chat directory's, else 'a team member' -- never a raw chat id. Null when entity_ref is not a person.

working_days.title: Working Days
working_days.description: Working days it moved the 85% date that day, later positive; null for a committed date's move or a day not taken apart.

pushed.title: Pushed
pushed.description: It moved the 85% date later: a change that pushed it.

moved_to.title: Moved To
moved_to.description: A committed date's move: the date it moved to.

PortfolioMarkDto.title: PortfolioMarkDto
PortfolioMarkDto.description: One change on a project's bar.

verdict.description: Null while no forecast row is kept for it.

target.title: Target
target.description: The committed date, else Jira's release date.

team_date.title: Team Date
team_date.description: The team's own date: the latest ETA or due date.

days_late.title: Days Late
days_late.description: Working days the 85% date lies after the target; negative: before it.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why it has its verdict, in one line that counts work items.

health.title: Health
health.description: Today's health in words (D92), e.g. '1 open blocker, 2 of 8 not replied'; never a colour.

health_day.title: Health Day
health_day.description: The day the rollup it is read from was kept.

start.title: Start
start.description: Where the bar starts: planning, else a month back.

kept_on.title: Kept On
kept_on.description: The day of the forecast row read.

PortfolioScopeResponse.title: PortfolioScopeResponse
PortfolioScopeResponse.description:
Each readable project against its plan, and the open Jira hygiene findings.

``counts_only``: the reader reads each rule's count, never an issue or an owner.

seen_since.title: Seen Since
seen_since.description: The first day drift sightings were recorded: an age from it is a lower bound.

PortfolioWarningsResponse.title: PortfolioWarningsResponse
PortfolioWarningsResponse.description: Early warnings grouped by kind, each with its count; findings attach to work items.

ProfileUpdateRequest.title: ProfileUpdateRequest
ProfileUpdateRequest.description: A catalog entry as the tenant wants it: a rename, hiding it, or a new one.

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: The request between people this ask is, when it is one: the console lists it under the caller's own asks and leaves it out of this table then.

ProjectAskDto.title: ProjectAskDto
ProjectAskDto.description:
One ask of who must act: what, who, how long, why. Ordered by the item, never by person.

For an executive ``who`` is the owning team and ``detail`` and
``escalated_to`` are empty: no one's name reaches them.

replied.title: Replied
replied.description: Gave the day's status themselves (confirmed or partial).

inferred.title: Inferred
inferred.description: Filled from what moved in the tracker and Git.

no_data.title: No Data
no_data.description: Closed stale or unknown: nothing said, nothing moved.

waiting.title: Waiting
waiting.description: No status for the day yet.

ProjectCheckinCoverageDto.title: ProjectCheckinCoverageDto
ProjectCheckinCoverageDto.description: How the day was captured across the project's people: counts, no names.

people.title: People
people.description: Everyone on the project's pods, each once; null for an executive when they are fewer than five (D104).

coverage.description: The day's check-ins, counted; null when ``people`` is.

ProjectCheckinCoverageResponse.title: ProjectCheckinCoverageResponse
ProjectCheckinCoverageResponse.description: ``GET /projects/{id}/checkin-coverage``: the day's check-ins over the project, counted.

stage.description: The stage an open request is in now; null for a merged one or when not known.

timed.title: Timed
timed.description: Whether the request's review history was read.

open_count.title: Open Count
open_count.description: Requests open at the end of the window.

timed_merged_count.title: Timed Merged Count
timed_merged_count.description: Merged requests whose review history was read, so their stages are timed.

unreviewed_merged_count.title: Unreviewed Merged Count
unreviewed_merged_count.description: Merged requests with no review by anyone but the author.

untimed_count.title: Untimed Count
untimed_count.description: Requests synced before review histories were read: counted, not timed.

stages_by_type.title: Stages By Type
stages_by_type.description: Every request type's own stage times and worst jam, over its requests alone: the same percentile rule as stages. A type with no request has its four stages with no time and a count of 0.

items_truncated.title: Items Truncated
items_truncated.description: More requests than the items list holds; counts and stage times cover all.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: What the figures leave out, in words.

repos.title: Repos
repos.description: The repositories read; null for every repository the tenant syncs.

member_count.title: Member Count
member_count.description: A pod's members whose requests count; null when authors are not narrowed.

measured_count.title: Measured Count
measured_count.description: Merged requests in the window whose time in this stage is known.

open_count.title: Open Count
open_count.description: Open requests in this stage now.

PullRequestStageHoursDto.title: PullRequestStageHoursDto
PullRequestStageHoursDto.description: Hours a request spent in each stage it finished; null for one not finished or not known.

PullRequestTypeFlowDto.title: PullRequestTypeFlowDto
PullRequestTypeFlowDto.description: One request type's own stage times and worst jam, over that type's requests alone.

PullRequestWorstJamDto.title: PullRequestWorstJamDto
PullRequestWorstJamDto.description: The stage requests spend longest in, at each percentile.

ReadinessBoardResponse.title: ReadinessBoardResponse
ReadinessBoardResponse.description: A project's (or a release's, or a pod's) criteria and where each stands.

version.title: Version
version.description: The draft's version the person approved.

criterion_id.title: Criterion Id
criterion_id.description: Empty creates one; an example's id adds it.

owner_profile.title: Owner Profile
owner_profile.description: A profile id (GET /profiles): while the criterion is missing, its holder in the scope's pods is asked to create or link it. Empty asks only the decider.

project_key.title: Project Key
project_key.description: Empty drafts into the scope's own Jira project.

version.title: Version
version.description: The draft's version as it was opened.

url.title: Url
url.description: A record outside Jira a person linked; empty for an issue.

strength.description: evidence: a match covers the criterion; candidate: it only makes it unsure.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: The agent checks scopes; off, a tick does nothing.

auto_suggest.title: Auto Suggest
auto_suggest.description: Draft a Jira issue for every missing criterion.

create_in_jira.title: Create In Jira
create_in_jira.description: Admin › Jira writes' "Create release-readiness issues": lets a person press Create in Jira; the tenant's Jira writes switch must be on too.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: The agent checks scopes; off, a tick does nothing.

auto_suggest.title: Auto Suggest
auto_suggest.description: Draft a Jira issue for every missing criterion.

create_in_jira.title: Create In Jira
create_in_jira.description: Sets Admin › Jira writes' "Create release-readiness issues"; left out or null, it stays as it is.

ReadinessSettingsUpdateRequest.title: ReadinessSettingsUpdateRequest
ReadinessSettingsUpdateRequest.description: The agent's settings. ``create_in_jira`` left out or null keeps the Jira writes switch.

RepliesCountDto.title: RepliesCountDto
RepliesCountDto.description:
The day's replies: ``replied`` (confirmed or partial) of ``people``, and
``inferred``, filled from the tracker and Git, never green.

names.title: Names
names.description: For people, the names of those who are members; anyone else is only counted.

ReportAudienceResponse.title: ReportAudienceResponse
ReportAudienceResponse.description: How many places of one kind a report goes to, and the people among them by name.

ReportDateFactsResponse.title: ReportDateFactsResponse
ReportDateFactsResponse.description: The delivery date as the report states it; what it leaves unsaid is null.

target.title: Target
target.description: A chat channel id, a member id, or an email address (a person or a mailing list). Empty for Teams, which posts to the Teams connection's channel.

ReportFactsResponse.title: ReportFactsResponse
ReportFactsResponse.description:
The report as structured facts, for the console to draw.

Built from the same computation as the report's lines, and holding nothing
the sent text does not say. Never part of what is sent.

ReportGateFactsResponse.title: ReportGateFactsResponse
ReportGateFactsResponse.description: One gate's requirements, each counted once: moved on without it, else by state.

ReportPreviewResponse.title: ReportPreviewResponse
ReportPreviewResponse.description: What the report would say if it were sent now. Nothing is sent or stored.

actor_name.title: Actor Name
actor_name.description: The display name of the member who sent it, or null when actor is no member's id or there is none (a scheduled run).

waiting_over_a_week.title: Waiting Over A Week
waiting_over_a_week.description: Open or acknowledged for 7 days or more.

not_delivered.title: Not Delivered
not_delivered.description: Open, and the DM to the person asked failed.

RequestCountsResponse.title: RequestCountsResponse
RequestCountsResponse.description: ``GET /cross-person-requests/counts``: the requests board as counts, no one named.

names_hidden.title: Names Hidden
names_hidden.description: No one is named: the caller reads no names.

RequestTrailResponse.title: RequestTrailResponse
RequestTrailResponse.description: ``GET /cross-person-requests/{id}/trail``: what happened to one ask, and what is due.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: unmatched (nobody matched the name; the requester was asked whom they meant), asked, acknowledged, named (in the day report, by the escalation matrix), nobody_above (due to go up, nobody named above), resolved, cleared (the merge landed) or closed (a copy of a newer ask).

state.title: State
state.description: done: it happened. due: the matrix makes it due and no day report has carried it (see report).

at.title: At
at.description: When, for a step of a moment.

on.title: On
on.description: The day, for a step of a day: the report that named it, or the day the matrix reaches it.

who.title: Who
who.description: The person at this step (the person asked, or whom the report names); null when not known or not read.

by.title: By
by.description: Who made it happen; null for OpenProgram itself.

dm.title: Dm
dm.description: On `asked`: the DM to the person asked was sent, is being retried, was not delivered, or none was sent.

dm_at.title: Dm At
dm_at.description: When the DM went out, if kept.

eta.title: Eta
eta.description: On `acknowledged`: when their reply said, in its words.

project_name.title: Project Name
project_name.description: The project whose day report carries a named step.

report.title: Report
report.description: On `named`: sent (a day report carried it), not_sent (none went out while it stood there), no_report (the project has no day report) or upcoming.

computed.title: Computed
computed.description: Worked out from the escalation matrix, not a recorded event.

from_stage.description: Null for a requirement new in scope.

to_stage.description: Null for one that left the scope.

points.title: Points
points.description: Story points per stage that day; a burn-down by points reads them only when has_points.

has_points.title: Has Points
has_points.description: True when every requirement counted that day carried story points.

timeline_days.title: Timeline Days
timeline_days.description: The calendar days the timeline covers, up to as_of.

forecast_needed_days.title: Forecast Needed Days
forecast_needed_days.description: Working days of history the tenant's forecast needs; the flow of stages draws once the timeline holds as many.

RequirementsResponse.title: RequirementsResponse
RequirementsResponse.description: A project's requirements by delivery stage, with counts over time.

owner_status_has_blockers.title: Owner Status Has Blockers
owner_status_has_blockers.description: True when the owner has an open blocker relevant to this finding's work item: either attributed to that work item or unattributed (could concern anything). A blocker attributed to a different work item does not count.

person_name.title: Person Name
person_name.description: Who entity_ref is, by name, when the finding is about a person (a merge request no work item claims is filed on its author): the member's name, else the chat directory's, else 'a team member' -- never a raw chat id. Null when entity_ref is not a person.

RuleScope.title: RuleScope
RuleScope.description: Which issue set a rule reads: readiness's scope builders.

ScopeDeliveryResponse.title: ScopeDeliveryResponse
ScopeDeliveryResponse.description: One scope's committed date and forecast: a project, a pod's part, or a release.

owner_name.title: Owner Name
owner_name.description: Null for a reader who sees no person.

asks.title: Asks
asks.description: Its rule asks the owner in the day report: nothing to send.

ScopeGroup.title: ScopeGroup
ScopeGroup.description: What kind of addition a requirement that joined the scope was.

plan.description: Null without a baseline, or for a reader of no baselines.

scope_day.title: Scope Day
scope_day.description: The stored snapshot the scope is read from.

asks.title: Asks
asks.description: The rule asks each owner in the day report.

ScopeSinceBaselineResponse.title: ScopeSinceBaselineResponse
ScopeSinceBaselineResponse.description: Today's scope against one baseline: keys only (at most 50 listed), never who.

SelfCheckinPreferenceUpdateRequest.title: SelfCheckinPreferenceUpdateRequest
SelfCheckinPreferenceUpdateRequest.description:
The part of their own check-in preference a person may change.

Only the days they are asked and their time zone. The reply windows stay
with an admin (``PUT /config/members/{id}/checkin-preference``) because they
decide when a missed check-in reaches the scrum master and manager. The
check-in time is left out because check-ins go out at one tenant-wide time,
so a personal time would change nothing. A request carrying any other field
is rejected, never silently ignored. A field sent as ``null`` goes back to
the team default.

SettingSource.title: SettingSource
SettingSource.description: Where an effective value comes from.

blocker_items.title: Blocker Items
blocker_items.description: Structured blocker corrections. When present, this is the authoritative set; the flat blockers list is ignored.

SyncHealth.title: SyncHealth
SyncHealth.description:
How much a reader can trust the data a source feeds in.

``DISABLED`` is a source that by design is not synced (the calendar is read
live). ``NOT_CONFIGURED`` has no recurring target, so nothing will refresh
it. Neither is ever reported as healthy.

SyncTargetOrigin.title: SyncTargetOrigin
SyncTargetOrigin.description: Where a source's recurring targets come from.

TaskStatementDto.title: TaskStatementDto
TaskStatementDto.description:
The person's latest statement on a task: a state or a note, when and where.

A chat statement carries its state only; a note is typed in the console.

TaskTrackerResultDto.title: TaskTrackerResultDto
TaskTrackerResultDto.description: What the tracker move did, as the task row says it.

move_in_tracker.title: Move In Tracker
move_in_tracker.description: True also moves the tracker issue to `state`; ignored without a state. Left out or null: the tracker is not touched.

TaskUpdateRequest.title: TaskUpdateRequest
TaskUpdateRequest.description:
One person's update of one of their tasks: only the fields that changed.

Every field is optional and at least one change must be sent
(``move_in_tracker`` alone is none). ``eta: null`` clears the ETA; leaving
``eta`` out keeps it. A field this model does not know is refused.

TenantLogoResponse.title: TenantLogoResponse
TenantLogoResponse.description: The tenant's logo, inline as a data URL. An ```` cannot send the API's auth headers, so the image travels inside this authenticated response instead of behind an image URL of its own.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: image/png, image/jpeg or image/webp. SVG is refused.

data_base64.title: Data Base64
data_base64.description: The file's bytes in standard base64, without a data: prefix. At most 256 KB once decoded.

TenantLogoUploadRequest.title: TenantLogoUploadRequest
TenantLogoUploadRequest.description:
A logo to upload: its declared type and its bytes, base64-encoded.

JSON rather than a multipart form, so the console's one authenticated,
CSRF-protected client sends it like any other change. The server checks the
bytes themselves; the declared type must match what they are.

TimelineMarkerResponse.title: TimelineMarkerResponse
TimelineMarkerResponse.description: One kind of event on one day, on a row's impact lane.

TimelineResponse.title: TimelineResponse
TimelineResponse.description: A project's or a pod's timeline: the axis, the rows, and each row in words.

TimelineTextResponse.title: TimelineTextResponse
TimelineTextResponse.description: The spoken summary of one row, worded by the server.

TimelineTickResponse.title: TimelineTickResponse
TimelineTickResponse.description: One value the committed date took, and the day it was set.

replies.description: The day's replies over the people counted; null for an executive when they are fewer than five (D104).

TodayCountsResponse.title: TodayCountsResponse
TodayCountsResponse.description: Today's counts over what the caller reads: the portfolio, or their own pods and projects.

TypeSource.title: TypeSource
TypeSource.description: Which rule gave a request its type.

none.title: None
none.description: Projects with no forecast row kept yet.

VerdictFilter.title: VerdictFilter
VerdictFilter.description: The filter chips: a project's verdict, as the reader picks it.

counts_only.title: Counts Only
counts_only.description: The reader reads this group's count, not its items.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: The drift kind, the risk rule, or 'blocker'.

age_known.title: Age Known
age_known.description: False: the age only counts from the first recording ('seen since').

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Who acts on it, by name; null where the reader sees the team instead.

WriteBackConsent.title: WriteBackConsent
WriteBackConsent.description:
Per-developer standing consent for automated issue-tracker write-back.

``always_ask`` (the safe default) never writes automatically; ``auto_apply``
grants standing consent; ``never`` opts out entirely.

WriteBackGateSource.title: WriteBackGateSource
WriteBackGateSource.description: Where the tenant-wide write-back switch takes its value from.

WriteBackStatus.title: WriteBackStatus
WriteBackStatus.description: Lifecycle of a single audited issue-tracker write.
